blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en:
Wildfires pose severe risks to human life, ecosystems, and property.
This study presents a machine learning approach for wildfire detection from GOES ABI imagery.
A CatBoost model was trained on a large dataset with thousands of ABI images and over 300,000 matching VIIRS fire detections.
An evaluation on a separate dataset across five regions showed that the learned CatBoost model outperformed the operational GOES Fire Detection and Characterization (FDC) product. It achieved higher precision, recall, and F1 scores both within and outside the training area. The CatBoost model achieved F1 scores that were 0.16 to 0.38 higher than the GOES FDC in all regions. In addition, out of 51 historical fire events, the CatBoost detected 26 fires before both VIIRS and GOES FDC, compared to only six earlier detections by the GOES FDC. Importantly, the CatBoost model achieved accurate wildfire detection also during nighttime, whereas the GOES FDC obtained very low recall values, around  0.03. This study demonstrates that machine learning models may offer significant improvements over existing geostationary fire products, including higher accuracy, fewer false alarms, and earlier detection.
blocks.zh:
野火对人类生命、生态系统和财产构成严重威胁。
这项研究介绍了从GOES ABI图像中探测野火的机器学习方法。
一个CatBoost模型在大型数据集上接受了培训,其中包括数千个ABI图像和超过30万个匹配的VIIRS火灾探测器.
对5个区域单独数据集的评价表明,已学习的CatBoost模型的性能超过了运行中的GOES火灾探测和特性(FDC)产品。 它在培训领域内外取得了更高的精确度、召回率和F1分数。 CatBoost模式的F1分数比所有区域GOES FDC高0.16至0.38分。 此外,在51起历史火灾事件中,CatBoost号在VIIRS和GOES FDC之前共探测到26起火灾,而GOES FDC此前仅探测到6起. 重要的是,CatBoost模型在夜间也实现了准确的野火探测,而GOES FDC获得的召回值很低,约为0.03。 这项研究表明,机器学习模型可能比现有的地球静止火灾产品大有改进,包括精度更高,虚假警报减少,以及早期探测。

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en:
Wildfires can have devastating impacts on the environment and pose serious threats to human life, ecosystems, and property.
A recent example is the Palisades Fire, which erupted in January 2025 in Los Angeles, California, resulting in 12 fatalities, destroyed more than 6,800 structures, and burning 95 km 2 of land over 24 days before being fully contained [ CAL FIRE, 2025 ] .
Given the rapid spread of such severe events, timely fire detection can help contain fires and prevent large-scale disasters. This is even more crucial nowadays, as the frequency of major disasters caused by wildfires has quadrupled from 1980 to 2023 [ Cunningham et al., 2025 ] .
blocks.zh:
野火可对环境产生毁灭性影响,对人类生命、生态系统和财产构成严重威胁。
最近的一个例子是2025年1月在加利福尼亚州洛杉矶爆发的帕利萨德斯大火,造成12人死亡,摧毁了6 800多个建筑,并在24天内烧毁了95公里2的土地,然后才被完全控制 [CAL FIRE, 2025].
鉴于此类严重事件的迅速蔓延,及时发现火灾有助于遏制火灾和防止大规模灾害。 这在当今更为关键,因为1980年至2023年,野火造成的重大灾害次数翻了两番[Cunningham等人,2025年]。

blocks.en:
A common approach to early wildfire detection is the use of satellite imagery, which provides wide-area coverage and frequent monitoring [ Chuvieco et al., 2020 ] .
Among satellite-based methods, geostationary (GEO) satellites are commonly used for wildfire detection [ Barmpoutis et al., 2020 ] .
Their orbital period matches Earth’s rotation, so they appear stationary from a fixed point on the ground and can monitor the same region every 5 to 15 minutes.
blocks.zh:
早期野火探测的一个共同办法是使用卫星图像,提供广域覆盖和频繁监测[Chuvieco等人,2020年]。
在基于卫星的方法中,地球静止轨道卫星通常用于野火探测[Barmpoutis等人,2020年]。
它们的轨道周期与地球的自转相匹配,因此它们从地面的固定点看是静止的,并且可以每5至15分钟监测同一个区域.

blocks.en:
Indeed, several dedicated fire detection products were developed for GEO satellite imagery.
Notable examples include the Fire Detection and Characterization (FDC) product of the American Geostationary Operational Environmental Satellite (GOES) [ Schmidt, 2020 ] , and the Fire Radiative Power (FRP-PIXEL) product of the European Meteosat Second Generation (MSG) satellite [ Wooster et al., 2015 ] .
These products are based on a combination of threshold and contextual criteria and have several known limitations. As discussed by Schmidt [2020] , some fire events are visible in the 3.7 µm band before the FDC algorithm detects them.
In addition, Hall et al. [2019] , Hall et al. [2023] report that the FDC and FRP fire products exhibit high false-alarm rates.
These findings highlight the need for fire detection algorithms with lower false-alarm rates and greater detection capabilities, particularly for small fires.
blocks.zh:
事实上,为地球观测卫星图像开发了若干专用火灾探测产品。
显著的例子包括美国地球静止实用环境卫星(GOES)的火灾探测和特性(FDC)产品[施密特,2020年],以及欧洲气象卫星第二代(MSG)卫星的火灾辐射动力(FRP-PIXEL)产品[伍斯特等人,2015年].
这些产品以阈值和背景标准相结合为基础,并有一些已知的局限性。 如施密特[2020]所讨论,一些火灾事件在FDC算法探测到之前,在3.7微米波段内可见.
此外,Hall et al. [2019], Hall et al. [2023] 报道称,FDC和FRP的消防产品表现出很高的假警报率.
这些调查结果突出表明,需要使用假警报率较低的火灾探测算法,并提高探测能力,特别是小火灾。

blocks.en:
A promising approach to address this challenge is to train machine learning (ML) algorithms for GEO fire detection.
ML algorithms have the potential to outperform traditional algorithms by learning fire-related complex spatial and spectral patterns from GEO satellite imagery [ Yang et al., 2024 ] .
Training a ML algorithm requires a labeled dataset consisting of multispectral imagery annotated at the pixel level as fire or non-fire.
These annotations are derived from independent reference sources.
Examples include high-resolution fire detections from Low Earth Orbit (LEO) satellite instruments [ Zhao and Ban, 2022 , Zhang et al., 2023 , e.g.,] , and fire records from national forest services [ Jang et al., 2019 , Kang et al., 2022 , Kang et al., 2023 , e.g.,] . After the model has been trained, given a new GEO image, its output is a binary image, indicating whether each pixel is fire or not.
Finally, it is common practice to evaluate the model’s accuracy on an independent dataset that was not seen during training.
blocks.zh:
应对这一挑战的一个有希望的方法是培训用于地球观测组织火灾探测的机器学习算法。
ML算法通过从GEO卫星图像中学习与火灾有关的复杂空间和光谱模式[Yang等人,2024],有可能超越传统算法.
训练一种ML算法需要有一个标签数据集,由多光谱图像组成,在像素水平上附加说明为火或非火.
这些说明来自独立的参考来源。
例子包括低地球轨道(LEO)卫星仪器的高分辨率火灾探测[赵和班,2022年,张等人,2023年],以及国家林业部门的火灾记录[张等人,2019年,姜等人,2022年,姜等人,2023年]. 在模型经过训练后,赋予一个新的GEO图像,其输出为二进制图像,表明每个像素是否是火.
最后,通常的做法是在培训期间没有看到的独立数据集上评价模型的准确性。

blocks.en:
Several studies considered ML approaches for GEO fire detection.
Some works used traditional ML algorithms, such as Random Forest (RF) [ Jang et al., 2019 , Zhang et al., 2023 , Maeda and Tonooka, 2023 , Liu et al., 2023 ] , while other studies applied Deep Learning (DL) algorithms, like Convolutional Neural Networks (CNNs) [ Hong et al., 2022 , Hong et al., 2024 , Ding et al., 2022 , Zhao and Ban, 2022 , Kang et al., 2022 , Kang et al., 2023 , Ji et al., 2023 ] .
These studies show the potential of ML algorithms for GEO fire detection.
Nevertheless, important limitations and gaps remain to be addressed.
blocks.zh:
一些研究考虑了地球观测组织火灾探测的多升方法。
一些作品使用了传统的ML算法,如Random Forest(RF)[张 al等人,2019年,张 Zhang等人,2023年,Maeda and Tonooka,2023年,Liu等人,2023年],而其他研究应用了Deep Learning(DL)算法,如Convolutional神经网络(CNNs)[. Hong et al., 2022年; Hong et al., 2024年; Ding et al., 2022年; Zhao and Ban., 2022年; Kang et al., 2022年; Kang et al., 2023年; Ji et al., 2023年).
这些研究表明ML算法对GEO火灾探测的潜力.
然而,重要的限制和差距仍有待解决。

blocks.en:
One gap is that most of the published ML models for GEO fire detection used relatively small training and evaluation datasets, containing only a few hundred annotated fire pixels.
In addition, both the training and evaluation regions covered only small-scale geographic areas. Furthermore, Most works did not assess the models’ generalization to regions outside the training areas.
Another issue is that, in many studies, the trained ML models were not empirically compared with the corresponding operational GEO fire detection algorithms. Furthermore, previous studies did not assess their model performance separately on daytime and nighttime images, but rather provided its overall accuracy.
Consequently, it is unclear whether these ML models truly outperform existing algorithms, particularly in terms of low false alarms and detection capability across a broad range of atmospheric conditions and over the large coverage areas of GEO satellites.
blocks.zh:
一个缺口是,大多数已公布的用于GEO火灾探测的ML模型使用相对较小的培训和评价数据集,只包含几百个附加说明的火像素.
此外,培训和评价区域只涵盖小规模地理区域。 此外,大多数工作没有评估这些模式在培训领域以外区域的普及情况。
另一个问题是,在许多研究中,经过培训的ML模型与相应的可操作的GEO火灾探测算法相比,没有经验性比较. 此外,以往的研究并没有在白天和夜间图像上分别评估其模型性能,而是提供了总体准确性。
因此,目前还不清楚这些ML模型是否真正超越了现有算法,特别是在低假警报和探测能力方面,在各种大气条件下以及在地球同步轨道卫星的广大覆盖地区。

blocks.en:
The primary goal of this study is to develop a robust ML model for GEO fire detection that outperforms the GOES FDC product in both detection accuracy and false-alarm rate.
To this end, we trained and evaluated a ML fire detection method using a large annotated dataset containing more than 60,000 GOES ABI fire pixels and ∼ \sim 1.2 million non-fire pixels. Reference labels for both training and evaluation were derived from the LEO Visible Infrared Imaging Radiometer Suite (VIIRS) active fire product.
A Gradient Boosting ML fire detection algorithm was trained on this dataset and evaluated on a large, separate dataset. The evaluation dataset includes images from regions not used in training and from a different time period. Specifically, the training data are from 2022–2023, while the evaluation data are from 2024. These differences in both space and time between the training and evaluation datasets enable a comprehensive assessment of the model’s generalization capability. In addition, the model performance was compared to the GOES FDC product in terms of overall detection and daytime/nighttime detection.
blocks.zh:
本研究的主要目标是开发一个强力的GEO火灾探测ML模型,在探测精度和假警报率上都优于GOES FDC产品.
为此,我们培训和评估了ML火灾探测方法,使用一个大型附加说明的数据集,包含超过6万GOES ABI火灾像素和\sim120万非火灾像素. 培训和评价的参考标签来自低地轨道可见红外线成像辐射计套件(VIIRS)活火产品。
一个渐变助推ML火灾探测算法在此数据集上接受了培训,并在一个大型,独立的数据集上进行了评价. 评价数据集包括未用于培训的区域和不同时期的图像。 具体而言,培训数据来自2022-2023年,评价数据来自2024年。 培训和评价数据集在空间和时间上的差异使得能够全面评估模型的通用能力。 此外,将模型性能与GOES FDC产品进行整体检测和日间/夜间检测对比.

blocks.en: 2 Study area and data sources
blocks.zh: 2 研究领域和数据来源

blocks.en:
This section describes the regions analyzed in the study and the satellite imagery acquired over them. The images were used to train and evaluate a ML model for GEO fire detection.
In addition, as detailed below, a set of specific fire events was compiled to compare the ML model’s early detection capabilities with those of the GOES FDC product.
blocks.zh:
本节介绍研究中分析的区域及其获得的卫星图像。 这些图像被用于训练和评估用于地球观测组织火灾探测的ML模型。
此外,如下文所详述的,汇编了一套具体的火灾事件,将ML模型的早期探测能力与GOES FDC产品的能力进行比较。

blocks.en: 2.1 Study area
blocks.zh: 2.1 研究领域

blocks.en:
The study area encompasses several regions in the United States, Mexico, and Canada, with diverse land-cover types, including forests, wetlands, deserts, agricultural and urban areas (Figure 1 ).
As illustrated in the figure, part of the study area was used solely for training, another solely for evaluation, and a third for both training and evaluation.
Specifically, the U.S. states of Florida, Alabama, Mississippi, Louisiana, and Oklahoma, as well as the Mexican states of Chihuahua and Durango, were used for training.
Texas and Georgia were used for both training and evaluation, whereas California, Oregon, Arizona, Utah, and a small region in British Columbia were used exclusively for evaluation.
The size of the training area is approximately 2.1 million km 2 , whereas that of the evaluation region is about 2 million km 2 .
blocks.zh:
研究区包括美国、墨西哥和加拿大的几个区域,土地覆盖类型多样,包括森林、湿地、沙漠、农业和城市地区(图1)。
如图所示,研究领域的一部分只用于培训,另一部分只用于评价,三分之一用于培训和评价。
具体来说,佛罗里达州,阿拉巴马州,密西西比州,路易斯安那州和俄克拉荷马州,以及墨西哥奇瓦瓦州和杜兰戈州都被用于训练.
德克萨斯州和乔治亚州都被用于培训和评价,而加利福尼亚州,俄勒冈州,亚利桑那州,犹他州,以及不列颠哥伦比亚省的一个小地区则专门用于评价.
培训区面积约为210万平方公里,而评价区面积约为200万平方公里。

blocks.zh: 图1:研究区地图。 训练州以黑色为标志,评价州以红色为标志,两者使用的州以浅蓝色为标志.

blocks.en: 2.2 Data sources
blocks.zh: 2.2 国家 数据来源

blocks.en:
The training and evaluation datasets have the same structure.
Each dataset consists of VIIRS fire detections and matching GOES Advanced Baseline Imager (ABI) images acquired within a ± 2.5 \pm 2.5 min interval.
Further details on the data utilized from VIIRS and GOES ABI products are provided below.
blocks.zh:
培训和评价数据集的结构相同。
每个数据集包含VIIRS火灾探测和匹配GOES高级基线成像仪(ABI)在±2.5\pm2.5分钟间隔内获得的图像.
下文将进一步详细介绍来自第七批报告系统及GOES ABI产品的数据。

blocks.en:
The training dataset consists of all VIIRS fire detections in the study area throughout all of 2022 and 2023.
It contains 324,502 VIIRS fire detections and 4330 corresponding GOES ABI images.
The evaluation dataset contains VIIRS fire detections from selected months in 2024, see Table 1 .
The following paragraphs elaborate on the specific data sources used to construct the training and evaluation datasets. These include the VIIRS active fire product, GOES ABI imagery, and fire perimeter data.
blocks.zh:
培训数据集包括整个2022年和2023年研究区的所有VIIRS火灾探测.
它包含324,502 VIIRS火灾探测器和4330个相应的GOES ABI图像.
评价数据集载有2024年选定月份的VIIRS火灾探测,见表1。
以下各段阐述了用于构建培训和评价数据集的具体数据来源。 其中包括VIIRS活性火灾产品、GOES ABI图像和防火周边数据。

blocks.zh: 表1:评价数据集

blocks.en: 2.2.1 VIIRS active fire product
blocks.zh: 2.2.1 VIIRS活火产品

blocks.en:
In this work, data from the VIIRS instrument onboard the Suomi National Polar-orbiting Partnership (Suomi NPP) satellite were used as a reference.
Specifically, reference fire labels were derived from VIIRS active fire product VNP14IMG Collection 2 [ Schroeder et al., 2014 ] .
blocks.zh:
在这项工作中,以Suomi国家极地轨道伙伴关系卫星(Suomi NPP)上VIIRS仪器的数据作为参考。
具体来说,参考火标签来源于VIIRS活性火产品VNP14IMG Collection 2[Schroeder等人,2014].

blocks.en:
The VNP14IMG product has a spatial resolution of 375 m. For each fire detection (pixel), it provides its location (latitude and longitude), acquisition date and time, fire radiative power (FRP), and confidence level.
Fire detections with low confidence were deemed insufficiently reliable to serve as a reference and were thus excluded from the dataset.
The data were downloaded from NASA’s Level-1 and Atmosphere Archive and Distribution System Distributed Active Archive Center (LAADS DAAC) 1 1 1 https://ladsweb.modaps.eosdis.nasa.gov , accessed on 1 February 2026 .
blocks.zh:
VNP14IMG产品空间分辨率为375米. 对于每个火探测器(像素),它提供了其位置(纬度和经度),获取日期和时间,火的辐射功率(FRP),以及信心水平.
信心不足的火灾探测被认为不够可靠,无法作为参考,因此被排除在数据集之外。
这些数据是从美国航天局的一级和大气档案和分发系统分布式活动档案中心下载的。

blocks.en: 2.2.2 GOES ABI images
blocks.zh: 2.2.2 GOES ABI图像

blocks.en:
Three GOES ABI products with a spatial resolution of 2 km were downloaded: (1) Multi-channel Cloud and Moisture Imagery (MCMI); (2) Clear Sky Mask (ACM); and (3) FDC.
The MCMI and ACM data serve as input to the ML model, while the FDC data serves as the benchmark fire detector against which we compare our trained ML model.
The MCMI provides 16-band multispectral images. The complementary ACM indicates which pixels are cloudy and was used for cloud masking. The FDC product uses a contextual algorithm based on thermal infrared bands to identify thermal anomalies. It assigns each pixel a value indicating whether it is a fire. Pixels classified as fire have a corresponding confidence category. These categories reflect the algorithm’s confidence level that the detected fire is indeed a fire [ Schmidt et al., 2020 ] .
For evaluation analysis (Section 3.4 ), all of the FDC confidence categories were included.
For the early detection analysis (Section 4.4 ), the evaluation was performed twice. First, only the processed and saturated categories were used, as they have the lowest false alarm rates among the FDC categories [ Hall et al., 2023 ] . Second, the high category was added to the previous ones. Despite its higher false-alarm rate, it was included to assess whether it enables earlier fire detection.
Both GOES-16 and GOES-18 ABI products were downloaded in Continental United States (CONUS) and Pacific U.S. (PACUS) scan modes, respectively, using the GOES Python library 2 2 2 https://pypi.org/project/GOES/ , accessed on 1 February 2026 (version 3.9.23).
blocks.zh:
三个 空间分辨率为2公里的ABI产品被下载: (1) 多渠道云湿成像(MCMI); (2) 清空遮罩(ACM);和(3) FDC.
MCMI和ACM数据是对ML模型的投入,而FDC数据则作为基准火灾探测器,我们以此比较我们训练有素的ML模型.
MCMI提供16波段多光谱图像. 互补的ACM表示哪些像素是云层,曾用于云层遮盖. FDC产品使用基于热红外波段的上下文算法来识别热异常. 它为每个像素分配一个数值,表示它是否是火. 分类为火的像素有相应的置信类. 这些类别反映了算法的信心水平,即探测到的火确实是一种火[Smidt等人,2020年].
关于评价分析(第3.4节),所有金融开发公司信任类别都包括在内。
关于早期检测分析(第4.4节),进行了两次评价。 首先,只使用了经加工的和饱和的类别,因为这些类别在FDC类别中虚假警报率最低[Hall等人,2023年]。 第二,在前几例中增加了高级类别。 尽管假警报率较高,但列入评估是否能够及早发现火灾。
GOES-16和GOES-18 ABI产品分别在美国大陆(CONUS)和太平洋(PACUS)扫描模式下下载,使用GOES Python库2 2 2 https://pypi.org/project/GOES/,于2026年2月1日查阅(第3.9.23版).

blocks.en: 2.2.3 Fire perimeter data for early detection assessment
blocks.zh: 2.2.3 国家 用于早期探测评估的防火周边数据

blocks.en:
To compare the early-detection capabilities of the ML model and the GOES FDC (Section 4.4 ), a dataset of fire-perimeter measurements for 51 specific fire events was constructed as follows. The perimeter data was retrieved from the Wildland Fire Interagency Geospatial Services database (WFIGS) 3 3 3 https://data-nifc.opendata.arcgis.com/datasets/nifc::wfigs-current-interagency-fire-perimeters/about , accessed on 1 February 2026 .
The data contains polygons representing the mapped perimeters of wildfire events across the U.S.
The locations of the fire events are shown in Figure 2 . Further details regarding the 51 fire events appear in
Table A.1 in Appendix A .

为了比较ML模型和GOES FDC(第4.4节)的早期探测能力,为51个特定火灾事件构建了一个火周测量数据集如下。 周边数据从荒地消防机构间地理空间服务数据库(WFIGS)3 3 3 https://data-nifc.opendata.arcgis.com/datasets/nifc:wfigs-current-international-fire-perimes/about.,2026年2月1日查阅.
数据包含多边形,代表了全美野火事件的周边分布图.

blocks.en: 3 Methodology
blocks.zh: 3 方法

blocks.en: As detailed below, the construction of the ML fire detection algorithm consists of the following steps: (i) Spatial assignment of VIIRS fire detections to the GOES ABI grid (Section 3.1 ). (ii) Construction of the labeled dataset (Section 3.2 ). (iii) ML model training (Section 3.3 ). (iv) ML model evaluation (Section 3.4 ). blocks.en: 3.1 Assigning VIIRS fire detections to GOES ABI grid
blocks.zh: 3.1 将VIIRS火灾探测器分配给GOES ABI电网

blocks.en:
As mentioned above, VIIRS and GOES ABI have different spatial resolutions and grid systems.
Thus, to label GOES ABI pixels as fire/no fire, VIIRS fire detection pixel centroids were rasterized onto the GOES ABI fixed grid. The rasterized output is a GOES ABI grid, in which each pixel represents the number of VIIRS fire-detection centroids that intersect it. Pixels without any VIIRS fire-detection intersections were assigned a value of 0. Figure 3 illustrates the rasterize function, available in the Rasterio Python library 5 5 5 https://rasterio.readthedocs.io/en/stable/api/rasterio.features.html , accessed on 1 February 2026 [ Gillies, 2019 ] .
blocks.zh:
如上所述,VIIRS和GOES ABI具有不同的空间分辨率和网格系统.
因此,为了将GOES ABI像素标注为火/无火,VIIRS火探测像素中间体被光栅化成GOES ABI固定网格. 光栅化的输出是一个GOES ABI网格,其中每个像素代表其交汇的VIIRS火测百分数. 没有任何VIIRS火灾探测路口的像素被分配到0. 图3显示了光栅化的功能,见Rasterio Python图书馆 5 5 5 https://rasterio.readthedocs.io/en/stable/api/rasterio.features.html,于2026年2月1日查阅 [Gillies, 2019].

blocks.en:
The VIIRS instrument captures imagery in successive swaths known as scan lines.
Due to its technical properties, there is an overlap between VIIRS pixels from adjacent scan lines.
This phenomenon is commonly referred to as the bow-tie effect [ Seaman et al., 2015 ] .
Most of these duplicated pixels are removed onboard the instrument.
However, residual bow-tie pixels remain and may affect the analysis.
Thus, duplicated VIIRS pixels were removed using the method described by Vanunu et al. [2026] .
blocks.zh:
VIIRS仪器在被称为扫描线的连续片中捕捉图像.
由于其技术特性,VIIRS像素与相邻的扫描线存在重叠.
这种现象通常被称为弓领效应[Seaman等人,2015].
这些重复的像素大多在仪器上被移除.
然而,残留的弓领像素依然存在,并可能影响分析.
因此,重复的VIIRS像素被使用Vanunu等人[2026]描述的方法去除.

blocks.en: 3.2 Labeled dataset construction
blocks.zh: 3.2 标签数据集建设

blocks.en:
Next, we describe the process to label GOES ABI pixels as fire/no fire. These steps include handling spatial misalignments between VIIRS and GOES ABI fire detections, labeling non-fire pixels, and extracting input features for the ML model.
A significant challenge in constructing a labeled dataset is the frequent spatial misalignment between VIIRS fire detections and GOES ABI observations.
As shown in several studies [ Pestana and Lundquist, 2022 , Ayala et al., 2023 , Vanunu et al., 2026 ] , there can be displacements of several kilometers between GOES ABI and VIIRS fire pixel locations.
This, in turn, can significantly affect the accuracy of the trained ML model.
blocks.zh:
接下来,我们将GOES ABI像素标记为火/无火的过程描述. 这些步骤包括处理VIIRS和GOESABI火灾探测器之间的空间错配,标注非火像素,为ML模型提取输入特性.
构建一个标注数据集的一个重大挑战是,VIIRS火灾探测和GOES ABI观测之间经常出现空间错配.
如一些研究[Pestana and Lundquist, 2022年, Ayala等人, 2023年, Vanunu等人, 2026年] 所示, GOES ABI 和 VIIRS 消防像素地点之间可能会有数公里的迁移.
这反过来会大大影响训练有素的ML模型的准确性.

blocks.en:
To ensure accurate labeling of GOES ABI fire pixels that takes into account spatial misalignments, a buffer window was applied.
Specifically, let V V be the rasterized image. A value V ⁡ ( i , j ) ≥ 1 V(i,j)\geq 1 represents a VIIRS fire detection at ABI grid location ( i , j ) (i,j) in the rasterized output (Section 3.1 ).
Similarly, let G ⁡ ( i , j ) G(i,j) denote a pixel at the same location and time stamp in the GOES MCMI image.
As illustrated in Figure 4 , for each location ( i , j ) (i,j) with V ⁡ ( i , j ) ≥ 1 V(i,j)\geq 1 , a 3 × 3 3\times 3 buffer window was applied around G ⁡ ( i , j ) G(i,j) .
Within this window, the GOES ABI pixel with the highest fire signal, quantified by the Fire Index (FI), was labeled as a fire pixel.
The FI [ Zhao and Ban, 2022 ] is the normalized ratio between the shortwave infrared (SWIR) band at 3.9 µm and the thermal infrared (TIR) band at 11.2 µm: F ​ I = B 3.9 − B 11.2 B 3.9 + B 11.2 FI=\frac{B_{3.9}-B_{11.2}}{B_{3.9}+B_{11.2}} (1) where B 3.9 B_{3.9} and B 11.2 B_{11.2} are the GOES ABI brightness temperatures (in Kelvin) at 3.9 µm and 11.2 µm bands, respectively. The 3.9 µm band is sensitive to fires, while the 11.2 µm band is not. High FI values are associated with active fires and thus considered a reliable indicator of fire presence [ Zhao and Ban, 2022 ] .

为确保考虑到空间错位的GOES ABI火像素的准确标签,采用了缓冲窗口.
具体来说,让VV成为光线化的图像. 1 V (i, j)\ geq 1 表示在 ABI 网格位置 (i, j) (i, j) 在光栅化输出中(第3.1节)进行VIIRS火灾探测。

如图4所示,每个地点(i, j, i, j)与 V + + i, j, 1 V (i, j)\ geq 1, 在 G + 周围应用了一个 3 x 3\ 3\ 3 次 3 缓冲窗口 。
在这个窗口内,以火指数(FI)量化的具有最高火信号的GOES ABI像素被标注为火像素.
FI [赵和班,2022]是短波红外波段(SWIR)3.9微米与热红外波段(TIR)11.2微米的正比:FI = B 3.9 – B 11.2 B 3.9 + B 11.2 FI=\frac{B_{3.9}-B_{11.2}}{B_{3.9}+B_{11.2}}. (1) 其中B 3.9 B_{3.9}和B 11.2 B_{11.2}分别为3.9微米和11.2微米波段的GOES ABI亮度温度(以开尔文计算). 3.9微米波段对火灾敏感,而11.2微米波段则不敏感. 高FI值与活火相关,因此被认为是火灾存在的可靠指标[赵和班,2022].

blocks.en:
Note that applying a (square or circular) buffer window around a GEO fire detection is common practice in evaluating the accuracy of GEO fire products [ Freeborn et al., 2014 , Wickramasinghe et al., 2020 , Xu et al., 2017 , Xu et al., 2021 , Hall et al., 2019 , Hall et al., 2023 , e.g.,] .
If a LEO fire detection falls within this window, the GEO fire detection is considered a valid fire. Here, in contrast, the buffer window is placed around the VIIRS fire detection, and the purpose is different: to label GEO pixels as fires while accounting for and correcting potential misalignments.
blocks.zh:
请注意,在GEO火灾探测周围采用一个(平方或圆的)缓冲窗口是评价GEO火灾产品准确性的常见做法[Freeborn等人,2014年,Wickramasinghe等人,2020年,徐等人,2017年,徐等人,2021年,Hall等人,2019年,Hall等人,2023年,等等].
如果低地球轨道的火灾探测属于这个窗口,地球同步轨道的火灾探测就被认为是有效的火灾. 与此相对照,缓冲窗口被放置在VIIRS火灾探测器周围,目的也不同:将GEO像素标注为火灾,同时核算和纠正潜在的错配.

blocks.en:
For non-fire pixel labeling, from each GOES ABI image, 500 pixels that satisfy the following two requirements were selected:
(1) It cannot intersect a labeled fire pixel in a 3 × 3 3\times 3 window.
(2) It cannot be within a 3 × 3 3\times 3 window of any pixel with V ⁡ ( i , j ) > 1 V(i,j)>1 in the corresponding image V V .
These requirements ensure non-fire pixels are distant from fire-labeled pixels.
blocks.zh:
对于非点火像素标签,从每个 GOES ABI 图像中选择了500像素,这些像素满足了以下两个要求:
(1)不能在3×3 3\times 3窗口中交叉标注的火像素.
(2)它不能在任何像素的3×3 3的窗口内,在对应的图像V V 中,它与 V →(i,j) > 1 V (i,j) > 1的像素.
这些要求确保非火像素远离火标像素.

Right: A 3 × 3 3\times 3 window is applied in the GOES MCMI matrix G G . The pixel G ⁡ ( i ′ , j ′ ) G(i^{\prime},j^{\prime}) with the highest FI value is labeled as fire.

blocks.en:
For each labeled pixel (fire or non-fire), the values of all its 16 bands as well as its FI value were extracted.
Additionally, a 3 × 3 3\times 3 window was applied around each pixel to obtain its spatial context.
From the pixels within the window (excluding the center pixel), five statistics were computed for all 17 bands (including the FI): mean, median, minimum, maximum, and standard deviation.
Pixels flagged as cloud-covered by the ACM product were excluded from these calculations. If all of the neighboring pixels were flagged as clouds, a fill value of -999 was assigned.
The number of contextual features is 5 × 17 = 85 5\times 17=85 .
In total, there are 102 features (17 band values at the center pixel and 85 contextual features).
blocks.zh:
对于每个标注的像素(火或非火),都提取了其所有16个波段的值及其FI值.
此外,在每个像素周围应用了一个3×3 3\times 3窗口,以获得其空间背景。
从窗口内的像素(不包括中像素)中,计算出所有17个波段(包括FI)的5个统计数据:平均值,中值,最小值,最大值,和标准偏差.
ACM产品标为云覆盖的像素被排除在这些计算之外。 如果所有的相邻像素被标注为云,则指定了-999.
上下文特征数为5×17=85 5\时17=85.
总共有102个特征(中像素的带值17个,背景特征85个).

blocks.en:
To exclude small fires that the GOES ABI struggles to detect, two filtering criteria were applied to the fire-labeled pixels:
(1) The number of VIIRS fire detections in the 3 × 3 3\times 3 window around the center pixel at the corresponding matrix V V was required to be ≥ 2 \geq 2 ; and
(2) The FI value was required to be > 0 >0 .

Next, the class imbalance between fire and non-fire pixels was addressed.
Satellite-based wildfire detection datasets are highly imbalanced, as non-fire pixels greatly outnumber fire pixels.
To mitigate this, a 1:20 ratio of fire to non-fire pixels was applied.
This ratio was chosen to preserve sufficient background pixels while preventing the non-fire class from dominating the model training.
Ratios of 1:10 and 1:30 were also tested. Although the 1:30 ratio achieved similar precision, the 1:20 ratio was selected because its better F1 score.
In summary, the training dataset contained 202,000 fire-labeled and 2,165,000 non-fire-labeled GOES ABI pixels. After the filtering criteria were applied, 65,877 fire-labeled and 1,317,540 non-fire-labeled pixels remained.
blocks.zh:
接下来,解决了火与非火像素之间的阶级不平衡.
基于卫星的野火探测数据集高度不平衡,因为非火像素数量大大超过火像素.
为了缓解这种情况,采用了火与非火像素的1:20比例.
选择这个比例是为了保留足够的背景像素,同时防止非火课主导模型训练.
还测试了1:10和1:30的比率。 虽然1:30的比例实现了相似的精确度,但1:20的比例之所以被选中,是因为其更好的F1分.
简而言之,培训数据集包含202,000个消防标签和2,165,000个无消防标签的GOES ABI像素. 在采用过滤标准后,仍有65,877个火标和1,317,540个无火标像素.

blocks.en: 3.3 Model training
blocks.zh: 3.3 示范培训

blocks.en: In this study, a CatBoost [ Prokhorenkova et al., 2018 ] algorithm was trained to detect fires. CatBoost (Categorical Boosting) is a gradient-boosting method that builds an ensemble of decision trees. Each tree is trained to correct the errors made by the earlier trees.
blocks.zh: 在本研究中,一个CatBoost [Prokhorenkova等人,2018年]算法接受了检测火灾的培训. CatBoost(英语:Catographical Boosting)是一种梯度促进方法,它构建了一组决策树. 每棵树都经过训练,以纠正早期树所犯错误.

blocks.en:
CatBoost can process different types of input features without complex pre-processing. It handles numerical values and categorical variables in a unified way. Unlike traditional gradient boosting
frameworks, CatBoost incorporates specific algorithmic innovations to improve accuracy and generalization. These include: (1) ordered boosting, a technique that shuffles training data to prevent the model from memorizing the target (’target leakage’); (2) native handling of categorical variables, which avoids the need for complex pre-processing of non-numerical data; and (3) oblivious decision trees, a balanced tree structure that acts as a regularizer to prevent overfitting and significantly speeds up prediction times.
CatBoost has been widely applied across a variety of domains [ Hancock and Khoshgoftaar, 2020 ] ,
including remote sensing [ Zhang et al., 2022 ] .
The training dataset was randomly divided into 80% for training and 20% for validation. Further details regarding the CatBoost model training are provided in
Appendix B .
blocks.zh:
CatBoost可以处理不同类型的输入特性,而无需复杂的预处理. 它统一处理数值和绝对变量。 不同于传统的梯度提升
CatBoost将具体的算法创新纳入框架,以提高准确性和概括性。 其中包括:(1) 有序的增强,一种洗涤训练数据以防止模型记忆目标( ' 目标渗漏 ' )的技术;(2) 绝对变量的本土处理,避免了对非数字数据进行复杂预处理的必要性;(3) 忽略决策树,一种平衡的树结构,起到调节器的作用,防止过度调整和大大加快预测时间.
CatBoost已被广泛应用于多个领域[Hancock and Khoshgoftaar, 2020],
包括遥感[张等,2022].
培训数据集随机分为80%用于培训,20%用于验证. 有关CatBoost模式培训的进一步详情载于

To evaluate the accuracy of a fire detection algorithm, spatial misalignments between GOES ABI and VIIRS observations were considered.
Similar to Section 3.2 , let M ⁡ ( i , j ) = 1 M(i,j)=1 denote that at ABI pixel location ( i , j ) (i,j) the fire detection algorithm predicted a fire.
A pixel ( i , j ) (i,j) with M ⁡ ( i , j ) = 1 M(i,j)=1 is classified as a True Positive (TP) if there is at least one V ⁡ ( i ′ , j ′ ) ≥ 1 V(i^{\prime},j^{\prime})\geq 1 within a 3 × 3 3\times 3 window around ( i , j ) (i,j) .
Otherwise, the pixel is considered a False Positive (FP).
A False Negative (FN) pixel is defined as follows.
If the 3 × 3 3\times 3 window around V ⁡ ( i , j ) ≥ 1 V(i,j)\geq 1 does not contain a model fire detection, then the pixel is defined as FN.
The calculation of FN, TP, and FP with a 3 × 3 3\times 3 window is illustrated in Figure 5 . The red pixels are the model fire detections. In contrast, the pink pixels are rasterized VIIRS fire detections.

blocks.en:
The accuracy of a fire detection algorithm is evaluated by its recall, precision, and F1 scores.
These are standard metrics for classifier assessment.
In the context of fire detection, recall is the proportion of true fire pixels that the algorithm correctly identifies as fires.
Precision is the ratio of correctly detected fire pixels to the total number of flagged fire pixels by the algorithm.
The harmonic mean of precision and recall is the F1 score. All three metrics range from 0 to 1, where higher values indicate improved accuracy.

火灾探测算法的准确性通过它的召回,精度,以及F1的分数来评价.
这些是分类评估的标准衡量标准。
在火灾探测中,召回是算法正确识别为火灾的真实火灾像素的比例.
精度是算法正确检测到的火像素与标注火像素总数之比.
口琴精准和召回的平均值是F1分数. 所有三个度量从0到1,其中较高的值表明准确度有所提高。

blocks.en: 4 Results
blocks.zh: 4 结果

blocks.en:
This section presents the empirical evaluation results of the CatBoost model trained as described in section 3.3 .
In particular, we compare its performance with that of the GOES FDC in terms of accuracy, early-detection capabilities and ability to detect small fires.
blocks.zh:
本节介绍第3.3节所述培训的CatBoost模式的经验评价结果。
特别是,我们在准确性、早期探测能力和探测小火的能力方面,把它与GOES FDC的性能进行比较。

blocks.en: 4.1 CatBoost performance against the GOES FDC
blocks.zh: 4.1 针对GOES FDC的CatBoost性能

blocks.en:
Figure 6 a-c shows the recall, precision, and F1 scores, respectively, for the CatBoost model and the GOES FDC product across all five evaluation regions (Georgia, Texas, California-Oregon, Arizona-Utah and British Columbia).
The results show that the CatBoost model outperformed the GOES FDC product across all regions and evaluation metrics. It achieved lower false alarm rates and equal or higher detection rates.
In California–Oregon, Arizona-Utah and British Columbia, CatBoost performed better in recall, precision, and F1, regions that are not in the training dataset.
This demonstrates the transferability of the trained CatBoost model to regions outside the training areas.
In all regions, the CatBoost ML model achieved F1 scores that were 0.16-0.38 higher than those of the GOES FDC.
blocks.zh:
图6 a-c显示所有五个评价区域(格鲁吉亚、德克萨斯、加利福尼亚-奥雷贡、亚利桑那-乌塔赫和不列颠哥伦比亚)的CatBoost模型和GOES FDC产品的召回、精确和F1分数。
结果显示,CatBoost模型在所有区域的GOES FDC产品和评价衡量标准上都超过了其业绩。 它实现了较低的假警报率和相等或更高的探测率。
在加利福尼亚州-奥雷贡州,亚利桑那州-乌塔州和不列颠哥伦比亚省,CatBoost在召回,精准度和F1方面表现较好,没有在培训数据集中.
这表明训练有素的CatBoost模式可以转移到训练区以外的地区。
在所有区域,CatBoost ML模型的F1分数比GOES FDC的分数高0.16-0.38。

blocks.en: Figure 6: Comparison of performance metrics in terms of recall, precision, and F1 between the CatBoost model and the GOES FDC product in five different evaluation regions.
blocks.zh: 图6:CatBoost模型与GOES FDC产品在五个不同评价区域的回顾、精确度和F1方面的业绩计量比较。

blocks.en:
Going beyond the quantitative evaluation described above, it is instructive to look at two specific fire events, one in Texas and the other in Georgia. Figure 7 shows the CatBoost model’s predictions.
The green squares of width 375 m, are fires detected by the VIIRS fire product on images of the two regions taken at matching times (up to ± 2.5 \pm~2.5 min).
The left image is of Texas on 19 March 2024 at 19:36 UTC, and the right image is of Georgia on 19 February 2024 at 18:41 UTC. CatBoost pixels are marked in red for TP, purple for FP, and blue for FN. In Texas, the FP pixel is near the TP, suggesting that proximity to the heat source may have caused misclassification. In Georgia, small fires with single VIIRS detections were missed by the model and labeled as FN.
blocks.zh:
除了上述定量评价之外,审视两个具体的火灾事件是很有启发性的,一个发生在德克萨斯州,另一个发生在格鲁吉亚。 图7显示了CatBoost模型的预测。
宽度375米的绿色方块,是VIIRS火药产品在两个区域相匹配时间拍摄的图像上探测到的火灾(最高为±2.5\pm~2.5分钟).
左图是2024年3月19日19:36 UTC,右图是2024年2月19日18:41 UTC. CatBoost像素以红色标注为TP,紫色标注为FP,蓝色标注为FN. 在德克萨斯州,FP像素在TP附近,这表明靠近热源可能导致分类错误. 在佐治亚州,该型号错过了单一VIIRS探测的小型火灾,并标注为FN.

blocks.en:
Figure 7: Example of CatBoost model predictions on the background of GOES-16 ABI FI images in Texas (left) and Georgia (right).
VIIRS 375 m fire detections are shown as green squares.
CatBoost prediction pixels are color-coded in red, purple, and blue for TP, FP, and FN, respectively.
blocks.zh:
图7:在德克萨斯州(左)和佐治亚州(右)的GOES-16 ABI FI图像背景上的CatBoost模型预测实例.
七. 第七届特别会议 375m的火灾探测显示为绿色方形.
CatBoost预测像素分别以红,紫,蓝三种颜色编码为TP,FP和FN.

blocks.en: 4.2 Daytime/nighttime performance
blocks.zh: 4.2 日间/夜间业绩

blocks.en: Following the evaluation of the CatBoost model against the GOES FDC, it is important to explore how the time of day impacts detection capabilities. In this section, we compare the accuracy fire detection accuracy of the CatBoost and FDC models during the day and during the night across all study regions. The separation between day and night images was determined according to the sunrise and sunset times for each region. These times were computed based on the longitude, latitude, and date of each image using the Sunrise-Sunset API 6 6 6 https://sunrise-sunset.org/api, accessed on 1 February 2026 . Table 2 details the separation of the full evaluation dataset into daytime and nighttime images. The dataset contains a relatively balanced number of day and night images for most regions.
blocks.zh: 在对GOES FDC进行CatBoost模型评价后,必须探讨日间撞击探测能力如何。 在本节中,我们比较了CatBoost模型和FDC模型在白天和夜间的准确度火探测精度,涉及所有研究区域。 昼夜图像的分离是根据每个区域的日出和日落时间确定的. 这些时间是使用日出-日落 API 6 6 https://sunrise-sunset.org/api,2026年2月1日查阅的,根据每个图像的经度、纬度和日期计算的。 表2详细列出了将全部评价数据集分为白天和夜间图像的情况。 数据集包含大多数区域的昼夜图像数量相对平衡.

blocks.en: Table 2: Number of daytime and nighttime GOES ABI images for all study regions.
blocks.zh: 表2:GOES所有研究区域的日间和夜间图像数量。

blocks.en: Figure 8 shows the recall, precision, and F1 scores of the CatBoost and GOES FDC in all study regions during nighttime (Figure 8 a) and during daytime (Figure 8 b). During the daytime, recall and precision are higher for the CatBoost model, except for recall in California-Oregon and precision in Georgia and British Columbia, which are almost identical between the two algorithms. For the F1 score, CatBoost is higher than the FDC in all study regions during the day.
blocks.zh: 图8显示所有研究地区夜间(图8a)和白天(图8b)CatBoost和GOES FDC的召回、精确和F1分数。 在白天,CatBoost模型的召回和精度较高,除了加利福尼亚-奥雷贡的召回和乔治亚和不列颠哥伦比亚的精度,这两种算法几乎完全相同. 对于F1分数,CatBoost在白天高于所有学习区的FDC.

blocks.en: During the nighttime, in contrast, the CatBoost algorithm is significantly more accurate than the FDC. Notably, the recall score of CatBoost is significantly higher than the FDC. In fact, the FDC recall is 0 in Georgia and Texas, and it is almost 0 in the other regions. This means the FDC fails to detect almost all fires in the nighttime images of the study dataset. In Georgia, precision could not be calculated because the FDC did not detect any true or false positives across all 84 images. In Texas and Arizona-Utah, the FDC precision was higher than CatBoost because of the low number of FDC detections. There were only 13 fire detections in 172 images in Texas, while there were 4,409 GOES ABI pixels with at least one VIIRS fire detection in them. Similarly, there were only 26 fire detections in 134 images in Arizona-Utah, compared to 850 GOES ABI pixels with at least one VIIRS fire detection. For comparison, the CatBoost model in the corresponding regions had 477 and 691 fire detections, respectively. In the remaining regions, CatBoost achieves higher precision. For the nighttime, the CatBoost F1 scores were significantly higher, ranging from 0.17 to 0.69, while the FDC ranged from only 0.01 to 0.1. Overall, these results demonstrate that the GOES FDC struggles to detect fires at night, and the CatBoost model provides superior nighttime detection capabilities.
blocks.zh: 在夜间,相比之下,CatBoost算法比FDC要精确得多. 值得注意的是,CatBoost的召回得分大大高于FDC. 事实上,格鲁吉亚和德克萨斯的FDC召回率为0,其他地区的召回率为近0. 这意味着FDC未能探测到研究数据集夜间图像中几乎所有的火灾. 在格鲁吉亚,精确度无法计算,因为金融数据中心没有在所有84幅图像中发现任何真实或虚假的阳性。 在德克萨斯州和亚利桑那-乌塔州,FDC的精度比CatBoost要高,因为FDC的检测数量很少. 德克萨斯州172幅图像中只有13幅火灾探测,而其中至少有4,409幅GOES ABI像素,其中至少有一次VIIRS火灾探测. 同样,亚利桑那-乌塔州134幅图像中只有26幅火灾探测,相比之下,850幅GOES ABI像素中至少有一次VIIRS火灾探测. 作为比较,相应区域的CatBoost模型分别有477次和691次火灾探测. 在其余地区,CatBoost实现了更高的精度. 在夜间,CatBoost F1的得分明显较高,从0.17到0.69,而FDC则只有0.01到0.1. 总体而言,这些结果表明,GOES FDC在夜间努力探测火灾,CatBoost模型提供了更好的夜间探测能力.

blocks.en: Figure 8: Recall, precision, and F1 scores of the CatBoost model and GOES FDC across all study regions. Panel A (upper) nighttime and Panel B (lower) daytime.
blocks.zh: 图8:所有研究区域的CatBoost模型和GOES FDC的回顾、精确度和F1分数。 A小组(上)夜时间和B小组(下)日时间。

blocks.en: 4.3 Impact of training dataset size on CatBoost performance
blocks.zh: 4.3 (中文(简体) ). 培训数据集大小对CatBoost性能的影响

blocks.en: To demonstrate the importance of a large and diverse labeled dataset, we compared the model described in section 3.3 with the following two additional models. The first is a CatBoost model trained on a random subset of only 2,000 fire pixels and 20,000 non-fire pixels. The second model was trained on 2,000 fire pixels and 20,000 non-fire pixels drawn only from April and May.
blocks.zh: 为了证明一个大而多样的标签数据集的重要性,我们把第3.3节所述的模型与以下两个补充模型进行了比较。 第一种是CatBoost模型,它训练的随机子集只有2000个火像素和20,000个非火像素. 第二种型号的训练为2000个火像素和20000个非火像素,只从4月和5月抽取.

blocks.en: Figure 9 a-c presents precision, recall, and F1 scores, respectively, for all five models across Georgia, Texas, California-Oregon, Arizona-Utah and British Columbia. The full model, trained on 66,000 fire pixel, shows substantially higher precision in Texas, California–Oregon and Arizona-Utah than the two reduced-size models, while all models display similar precision in Georgia. Precision in Texas is 0.87 for the 66,000-pixel model, which is significantly higher than 0.72 and 0.68 achieved by the two 2,000-pixel models. In California-Oregon, precision is 0.88 for the 66,000-pixel model and 0.79 and 0.75 for the smaller models. In Arizona-Utah, the precision is 0.81 for the 66,000-pixel model, compared to 0.5 and 0.42 for the small models. These results show that small training datasets lead to higher false-alarm rates, especially when the dataset is restricted to only some months of the year.
blocks.zh: 图9 a-c对格鲁吉亚、德克萨斯、加利福尼亚-奥雷贡、亚利桑那-乌塔赫和不列颠哥伦比亚的所有五个模型分别给出精确度、回顾率和F1分数。 训练在66000火像素上的完整模型在德克萨斯州,加利福尼亚州-奥雷贡州和亚利桑那州-乌塔州显示的精度大大高于两个缩小的模型,而所有模型在佐治亚州显示的精度都类似. 德克萨斯州精密度为6.6万像素模型的0.87,大大高于两个2000像素模型所实现的0.72和0.68. 在加利福尼亚-奥雷贡,精度为6.6万像素模型的0.88,较小的模型的精确度为0.79和0.75. 在亚利桑那-乌塔,6.6万像素模型的精度为0.81,而小模型的精度为0.5和0.42. 这些结果表明,小型培训数据集导致虚假警报率较高,特别是在数据集仅限于一年中几个月的情况下。

blocks.en: Recall values are generally similar across models, with differences of about 0.04. The main exception is Georgia, where the April–May model produces a recall of only 0.21, compared with 0.33 and 0.35 for the 66,000-pixel and 2,000-pixel models. This result highlights the potential limitations of using a dataset that covers only a few specific months.
blocks.zh: 各模型的召回值一般类似,差异约为0.04. 主要例外是佐治亚州,4-5月的型号只产生0.21的召回,而66000像素和2000像素的型号则分别是0.33和0.35. 这一结果突出了使用仅涵盖几个月的数据集的潜在局限性。

blocks.en: F1-scores are also similar across most models and regions, apart from the April–May model in Georgia and Arizona-Utah, which shows a clear drop in performance. In California–Oregon and Arizona-Utah, which were not part of the training area, the highest F1-score is achieved by the 66,000-pixel model. This indicates better transferability and generalization when the training dataset is large and diverse.
blocks.zh: 除了在格鲁吉亚和亚利桑那-乌塔的4-5月模式外,大多数模型和地区的F1-分数也相似,表现明显下降。 在加利福尼亚州–奥雷贡和亚利桑那州–乌塔(Arizona–Utah),它们不属于训练区,最高的F1-分由66000像素模型实现. 这表明,在培训数据集庞大和多样时,可更好地进行转让和普及。

blocks.en: In summary, the 66,000-pixel model produces far fewer false-alarms than the reduced training size models while maintaining similar recall. Training on a small or limited dataset can lead to increased false-alarms and decreased performance in regions outside the training domain.
blocks.zh: 简而言之,6.6万像素模型在保持类似召回的同时,产生的假警报量远少于减少的训练规模模型. 在培训领域以外的区域,关于小型或有限数据集的培训可导致虚假警报增加和业绩下降。

blocks.en: Figure 9: Comparison of performance metrics between CatBoost models using different number of fire pixels for training in five different evaluation regions.
blocks.zh: 图9:CatBoost模型之间使用不同数量的火像素在5个不同的评价区域进行培训的性能指标比较.

blocks.en: 4.4 Early detection capability
blocks.zh: 4.4 (中文(简体) ). 早期检测能力

blocks.en:
Early fire detection is crucial for extinguishing small fires before they escalate to large and destructive wildfires.
As mentioned in Section 2.2 , a dataset of 51 fires with their fire perimeters was constructed to compare the early detection capabilities of the CatBoost model and the GOES FDC.
First, for each fire event in the dataset, CatBoost model predictions and the corresponding FDC product were collected for all GOES ABI images acquired within the 8 hours preceding and 2 hours following the first VIIRS fire detection. Next, the images were cropped to a 10 km buffer around the fire polygon.
Lastly, the time difference between the first fire detection of the CatBoost model and the GOES FDC was computed (in minutes).
blocks.zh:
早期的火灾探测对于在小火升级为大规模破坏性野火之前扑灭小火至关重要.
如第2.2节所述,为比较CatBoost模型和GOES FDC的早期探测能力,建造了一套51场大火及其防火周边的数据集。
首先,对于数据集中的每一起火灾事件,CatBoost模型预测和相应的FDC产品被收集到GOES ABI所有图像在第一次VIIRS火灾探测前8小时和2小时之内获得. 接下来,图像被裁成10公里的缓冲,围绕着火的多边形.
最后,计算了CatBoost模型第一次火灾探测和GOES FDC之间的时间差(分钟)。

blocks.en: Figure 10 summarizes the time difference between the CatBoost and GOES FDC for 38 fire events where both methods detected the fire before the time of the VIIRS image first detection. Figure 10 a (left) shows the results using only the processed and saturated FDC categories, while Figure 10 b (right) includes also the high confidence category. The x-axis shows the time difference in minutes, and the y-axis lists the fire events. In 10 a, 22 fire events were first detected by CatBoost, with a mean earlier detection time of 20 min and a standard deviation of 17 min, while GOES FDC first detected only six fires. In 10 b, the FDC fire detection capability improved with the addition of the high category addition. The CatBoost first detected 19 fires with a mean earlier detection time of 18 min and a standard deviation of 16 min. Here the GOES FDC first detected nine fires. For both analyses, 10 fire events were detected simultaneously by the CatBoost model and GOES FDC and were therefore labeled as "0".
blocks.zh: 图10总结了CatBoost号与GOES FDC号在38次火灾事件中的时差,这两种方法在VIIRS图像首次探测之前都探测到了火灾. 图10a(左)显示只使用经过加工和饱和的FDC类别的结果,而图10b(右)也包含高信任类别。 x轴显示以分钟计的时间差,y轴列出火灾事件. 在10 a中,22起火灾事件首先被CatBoost检测到,平均更早的检测时间为20分钟,标准偏差为17分钟,而GOES FDC最初只检测到6起火灾. 在10b中,由于增加了高类别,FDC的火灾探测能力得到了提高。 CatBoost号首次探测到19起火灾,平均提前探测时间为18分钟,标准差为16分钟. 在这里,GOES FDC首先发现了九起火灾. 在这两种分析中,CatBoost模型和GOES FDC同时检测到了10起火灾事件,因此标注为"0".

blocks.en: A deeper examination of these results reveals several notable cases, specifically the Howell, Blue Stem, Candy Creek, and Silver King fires. For the Howell fire, CatBoost detected the event 60 minutes earlier than the GOES FDC when using only the processed and saturated categories. However, when the high category was included, the time difference became zero. In the Blue Stem fire, CatBoost initially detected the fire 55 minutes before the FDC. Yet, with the addition of the high category, the FDC detected the fire 115 minutes earlier than CatBoost. This indicates that the high category can sometimes enable the FDC to detect fires simultaneously with or earlier than the CatBoost model. Furthermore, the Candy Creek and Silver King fires were not detected at all by the FDC when restricted to the processed and saturated categories. Once the high category was added, both fires were detected by the FDC, and for the Candy Creek fire, the FDC even detected it 30 minutes earlier than CatBoost. These examples demonstrate that FDC categories with higher false alarm rates can, in certain situations, provide better early fire detection capabilities than the precessed and saturated categories.
blocks.zh: 对这些结果的更深入审查揭示了几个值得注意的案例,特别是豪威尔,蓝调,糖果溪和银王大火. 对于Howell火灾,CatBoost在仅使用经过加工和饱和的类别时,比GOES FDC早60分钟检测到事件. 然而,在列入高类别时,时差变为零. CatBoost在"蓝色蒸汽炉"(Blue Stem fire)中,最初在FDC前55分钟检测到火灾. 然而,由于增加了高类别,FDC比CatBoost早了115分钟探测到了火. 这表明,高类别有时可以使FDC与CatBoost模型同时或更早地探测火灾. 此外,FDC在仅限于加工和饱和类别时根本没有发现糖果溪和银王火灾。 一旦加入高类别,FDC就发现了这两处火灾,对于糖果溪大火,FDC甚至比CatBoost早30分钟探测到了. 这些例子表明,在某些情况下,假警报率较高的FDC类别比预装和饱和类别能提供更好的早期火灾探测能力。

blocks.en: Table 3 describes the remaining 13 fire events split into two categories: (1) The CatBoost model detected the fire and GOES FDC did not detect it before VIIRS; and (2) Neither CatBoost nor FDC detected a fire before the time of the VIIRS image.
blocks.zh: 表3说明其余13起火灾事件分为两类: (1)CatBoost模型探测到火,GOES FDC在VIIRS之前没有探测到火;(2)CatBoost和FDC在VIIRS图像拍摄之前都没有探测到火.

blocks.en: Overall, out of 51 fire events, CatBoost detected 26 fires before both VIIRS and GOES FDC in the first analysis, and 23 in the second analysis. Ten fires were detected simultaneously by CatBoost and GOES FDC, while nine were first detected by VIIRS. GOES FDC first detected six fires in the first analysis and nine fires in the second. These results demonstrate that the CatBoost model has substantially better early detection capabilities than the GOES FDC product.
blocks.zh: 总体而言,在51起火灾事件中,CatBoost在第一次分析中在VIIRS和GOES FDC之前发现了26起火灾,在第二次分析中发现了23起火灾。 CatBoost和GOES FDC同时探测到十起火灾,而七溴二苯醚首先探测到九起火灾。 GOES FDC在第一次分析中首先探测到六起火灾,在第二次分析中探测到九起火灾. 这些结果表明,与GOES FDC产品相比,CatBoost模型的早期检测能力要好得多。

blocks.en: Figure 10: First detection time difference between CatBoost and GOES FDC across fire events. Panel A shows the analysis using only the processed and saturated FDC categories, and Panel B includes the high category. Fire events that were detected simultaneously by CatBoost and GOES FDC have a time delta label of "0".
blocks.zh: 图 10:CatBoost和GOES FDC首次探测时差穿越火灾事件. 小组讨论会 A显示的分析只使用经过加工和饱和的FDC类别,B小组包括高类别。 CatBoost和GOES FDC同时检测到的火灾事件有时间三角形标签为"0".

blocks.en: Table 3: Summary of fire events detected (1) Only by CatBoost and VIIRS; (2) Only by VIIRS.
blocks.zh: 表3:检测到的火灾事件汇总 (1)仅按CatBoost和VIIRS进行; (2)仅按VIIRS进行.

blocks.en: 4.5 Fire detection probability
blocks.zh: 4.5 国家 火灾探测概率

blocks.en:
This section analyzes the CatBoost and GOES FDC fire detection probability as a function of the number of VIIRS fire detections within a spatial window of size 3 × 3 3\times 3 around the GEO pixel predicted as fire by the corresponding method.
This was done to assess the models’ sensitivity to different fire sizes. The approach presented here is similar to those conducted by Vanunu et al. [2026] .
blocks.zh:
本节分析CatBoost和GOES FDC的火灾探测概率,作为大小为3×3的空间窗口内VIIRS火灾探测次数的函数,围绕GEO像素通过相应方法预测为火灾.
这样做是为了评估模型对不同火灾规模的敏感性。 这里介绍的方法与Vanunu等人采取的方法相似[2026]。

blocks.en:
Let M M denote the binary image representing the output of a fire detection algorithm.
A pixel value of 1 indicates a detected fire, and 0 otherwise.

Hence, in most cases, the CatBoost model is more sensitive to small fires and is more likely to detect them.

blocks.en: 5 Discussion and conclusions
blocks.zh: 5. 讨论和结论

blocks.en:
In this study, a CatBoost model was trained for wildfire detection using a large, carefully annotated dataset of GOES-16 ABI imagery. CatBoost was selected for this task because it is a modern, highly efficient gradient boosting framework that is relatively simple to train.
The model was evaluated and compared to the GOES FDC product. For both training and evaluation, VIIRS fire detections served as a reference.
The analysis in this study focused on prediction accuracy, early-detection capability, and fire-detection probability.
blocks.zh:
在这项研究中,利用GOES-16 ABI图像的大型、精心注释的数据集,对CatBoost模型进行了野火探测培训。 CatBoost被选中执行这项任务,因为它是一个现代化的,高度高效的梯度提升框架,相对容易训练.
该模型得到了评估,并与GOES FDC产品进行了比较. 就培训和评价而言,第七届特别会议的火灾探测是参考文献。
本研究的分析重点是预测准确性,早期探测能力和火灾探测概率.

blocks.en:
The results demonstrate that the CatBoost model consistently outperforms GOES FDC across all five regions considered in the study. It achieved higher precision, recall, and F1-scores. Recall values were relatively low for both models. This is due to the coarse spatial resolution of ABI compared to VIIRS. As a result, small fires detected by VIIRS were classified as false negatives by both the GOES FDC as well as by the CatBoost model. Despite this limitation, CatBoost achieved a higher recall than GOES FDC. The superior performance of the CatBoost model in California–Oregon, Arizona-Utah and British Columbia indicates generalization ability to regions outside the training domain. These evaluation regions feature different climatic conditions and varying satellite view angles compared to the training data. Additional daytime/nighttime evaluation between the CatBoost and the GOES FDC revealed striking differences. While CatBoost maintained reliable nighttime detection, the GOES FDC nighttime recall dropped to near zero across all regions. This highlights the CatBoost capabilities for fire detection across all day hours.
In a different analysis, CatBoost models trained on smaller datasets highlighted the importance of training on a large, diverse labeled dataset for reliable detection and robust performance in regions outside the training area. Models trained on only 2,000 fire pixels exhibited substantially higher false-alarm rates and weaker transferability.
These findings have important implications for operational wildfire monitoring. Accurate detection is critical for rapid response, especially in remote regions. In addition, improved GEO-based detection can bridge the temporal gap between LEO satellite overpasses, providing continuous fire monitoring.
blocks.zh:
研究结果表明,CatBoost模型在研究中考虑的所有五个区域都一直优于GOES FDC。 它实现了更高的精度,召回和F1分数. 两个模型的召回值相对较低。 这是由于ABI与VIIRS相比空间分辨率较粗. 因此,七氟化铀探测器探测到的小火被GOES FDC和CatBoost模型归类为假底火。 尽管有这一限制,CatBoost的召回率仍高于GOES FDC。 CatBoost模型在加利福尼亚州-奥雷贡州,亚利桑那州-乌塔州和不列颠哥伦比亚州的优异表现表明,对训练领域以外的地区具有概括化能力. 与培训数据相比,这些评价区域具有不同的气候条件和不同的卫星观测角度。 CatBoost公司与GOES FDC公司之间的额外日间/夜间评价显示存在显著差异。 虽然CatBoost保持了可靠的夜间探测,但GOES FDC的夜间召回次数在所有区域都降至接近零。 这突出显示了CatBoost全天候的火灾探测能力.
在不同的分析中,CatBoost模型接受了关于较小数据集的培训,强调培训对于培训领域以外的区域进行可靠检测和强劲表现的大型、多样的标签数据集的重要性。 仅培训了2 000个消防像素的模型显示假警报率高得多,可转移性弱。
这些调查结果对野火行动监测有重要影响。 准确检测对快速反应至关重要,在偏远地区尤其如此。 此外,改进基于地球同步轨道的探测可以弥合低地轨道卫星通过之间的时间差距,提供持续的火灾监测。

blocks.en:
The results are consistent with previous studies on ML-based fire detection using GEO satellites. Kang et al. [2023] trained a GEO-based deep learning fire detection model using imagery from the Japanese Himawari-8 Advanced Himawari Imager (AHI). The model was trained over regions in Asia and demonstrated improved performance compared to the operational Himawari fire product. The reported F1 scores were 0.66 and 0.50 at in situ validation sites in Asia.
In addition, transferability analysis over Australia yielded an average F1 score of 0.68.
These F1 score ranges are comparable to those achieved in the current study.
Overall, their results showed promising potential for GEO-based ML fire-detection models applied across large geographic regions, potentially outperforming existing GEO fire products.
blocks.zh:
研究结果与以前关于利用地球同步轨道卫星进行基于ML的火灾探测的研究是一致的。 姜等编. [2023]利用日本喜马拉雅-8高级喜马拉雅成像仪(AHI)的图像,培训了基于全球环境展望的深层学习火灾探测模型. 该模式在亚洲各区域进行了培训,与可操作的喜马拉雅火产品相比,其业绩有所改善。 在亚洲的现场验证站,报告的F1分数分别为0.66分和0.50分。
此外,澳大利亚各地的可转让性分析得出F1平均得分0.68.
这些F1的得分范围与目前研究中达到的得分范围相当.
总体而言,其结果表明,在大地理区域采用基于全球环境展望的ML火灾探测模型的潜力大有可为,可能比现有的全球环境展望火灾产品要好。

blocks.en: Despite these advancements in the Asia–Pacific region, the application of machine-learning-based fire-detection methods to the GOES-ABI platform remains limited. To date, only one study has applied machine learning to GOES-ABI-based fire detection. Zhao and Ban [2022] trained a deep learning model on GOES-ABI imagery using a relatively small dataset constructed from only four major fire events. Reported F1 scores were 0.71, 0.63, and 0.18 for the Creek, Camp, and Doctor Creek fires, respectively. Their model detected 24 of 38 fires earlier than VIIRS, comparable to the early-detection capability observed in the present results. However, their evaluation was limited to a small number of individual fire events and did not include a comparison with the operational GOES Fire Detection and Characterization product.
blocks.zh: 尽管亚太区域取得了这些进展,但在GOES-ABI平台上采用基于机器学习的火灾探测方法仍然是有限的。 迄今为止,只有一项研究将机器学习应用于基于GOES-ABI的火灾探测。 Zhao和Ban [2022]使用仅由四大火灾事件构建的相对较小的数据集,对GOES-ABI图像进行了深层学习模型培训. 报道的F1分数分别是0.71分,0.63分和0.18分,分别是克里克号,坎普号,和医生克里克号大火. 其模型比VIIRS早探测到38起火灾中的24起,与本结果中观察到的早期探测能力相当. 然而,他们的评价仅限于少数个别的火灾事件,不包括与可操作的GOES火灾探测和特性产品进行比较.

blocks.en: While Zhao and Ban [2022] demonstrated the potential of deep learning for GOES ABI fire detection, our work extends their study in several important ways. We evaluated the model across large-scale geographic regions rather than focusing on a small number of specific large fire events. In addition, we benchmark our model against the GOES FDC, and to the best of our knowledge, this study is the first to do so. We also explicitly assessed early detection relative to both VIIRS and GOES FDC. In addition, we quantified the detection probability as a function of VIIRS fire detections, an aspect that has not been extensively investigated in prior ML GEO-based fire detection studies.
blocks.zh: 虽然赵和班[2022]展现了GOESABI火灾探测深度学习的潜力,但我们的工作以几个重要方式扩展了他们的研究. 我们评价了大规模地理区域的模式,而不是侧重于少数具体的大型火灾事件。 此外,我们以GOES FDC作为我们的模型的基准,据我们所知,这项研究是第一个这样做的。 我们还明确评估了与七溴化二苯并对二苯并呋喃(VIIRS)和GOES FDC有关的早期检测。 此外,我们把探测概率量化为VIIRS火灾探测的一种功能,在以往的基于MOL GEO的火灾探测研究中还没有对此进行广泛调查。

blocks.en:
Despite these contributions, it is important to note some limitations of our study. The algorithm was primarily tested in regions of the continental United States and parts of North America, and only the CONUS and PACUS scan modes were used. The model was not tested on full-disk imagery or regions such as the Amazon or Patagonia, and therefore, continental-scale transferability remains unexplored. In addition, only the CatBoost model was evaluated, and it is possible that other advanced machine learning models could yield similar results.
Furthermore, the evaluation relied exclusively on VIIRS as a reference. Other LEO satellites with higher spatial resolution or in situ fire datasets were not used. Fire detections from these datasets are commonly included in the evaluation of GEO fire detection models [ Hall et al., 2019 , Hall et al., 2023 , Li et al., 2020 , e.g.,] , as incorporating them can improve dataset labeling and evaluation.
blocks.zh:
尽管有这些贡献,但必须指出我们的研究有一些局限性。 该算法主要在美国大陆地区和北美部分地区进行测试,只采用了CONUS和PACUS扫描模式. 该模型没有在亚马逊或巴塔哥尼亚等全磁盘图像或区域进行测试,因此大陆规模的可转移性仍未探索. 此外,只评价了CatBoost模型,其他先进的机器学习模型也有可能产生类似的结果.
此外,评价完全依靠七份评估报告作为参考。 空间分辨率较高的其他低地轨道卫星或原地火灾数据集没有使用。 这些数据集的火灾探测通常包含在对GEO火灾探测模型的评价中[Hall等人,2019年,Hall等人,2023年,Li等人,2020年等],因为纳入这些数据可以改善数据集的标签和评价.

blocks.en: Overall, this study shows that a CatBoost-based model can improve wildfire detection from GOES ABI imagery. It provides higher accuracy, lower false-alarm rates, and earlier detection than the GOES FDC product. These improvements highlight the potential of machine learning to strengthen operational wildfire monitoring and support more effective fire management and decision-making.
blocks.zh: 总的来说,本研究显示,基于CatBoost的模型可以改进从GOES ABI图像中发现野火的情况. 它提供更高的精度,较低的假警报率,以及比GOES FDC产品更早的检测. 这些改进突出了机器学习加强野火业务监测以及支持更有效的火灾管理和决策的潜力。

blocks.en:
The CatBoost algorithm has several hyperparameters that control how the model learns. The learning rate sets how quickly the model adjusts its decision trees.
A smaller value, such as 0.01, makes learning more stable.
The number of iterations (500) determines how many trees the model builds. A larger number of iterations allow the model to capture more patterns in the data.
blocks.zh:
CatBoost算法有几种超参数,可以控制模型是如何学习的. 学习率设定了模型调整其决策树的速度.
数值较小,如0.01,使得学习更加稳定.
迭代数(500)决定了模型所建树木的数量. 更多的迭代使得模型能够捕捉到更多的数据模式.

blocks.en:
The depth of each tree (set to 8) controls how many decision levels the tree can create.
Deeper trees can represent more complex relationships between the input features.
The L2 leaf regularization value (set to 1) penalizes large leaf output values, preventing individual trees from excessively large prediction updates and thereby reducing overfitting.
The bagging temperature (set to 5) introduces randomness to the weights given to individual training samples, which also reduces overfitting.
blocks.zh:
每棵树的深度(设定为8)控制着树能创建多少决策级别.
更深的树可以代表输入特征之间更为复杂的关系.
L2叶规范值(设定为1)会惩罚大叶输出值,防止单个树木过大的预测更新,从而减少过度配色.
包式温度(设为5)引入了给个别训练样品的权重的随机性,这也降低了过度适应性.

blocks.en:
To estimate these values, we performed a 5-fold cross-validation grid search.
We optimized for precision to reduce the false-alarm rate.
blocks.zh:
为了估计这些值,我们进行了5倍的交叉验证网格搜索.
我们优化了精度 以降低假警报率

blocks.en:
Figure B.1 shows the ten most important features in the final model. Several of the higher-ranked features come from the fire index and its statistics.
This includes the fire index’s standard deviation, which incorporates information from neighboring pixels and helps the model detect local variability. Additionally, the 3.7 μ \mu m µm band, which is highly suitable for fire detection, demonstrated high importance. Interestingly, the 0.47 μ \mu m visible band also received relatively high importance. It is possible that the algorithm uses this visible band to differentiate between daytime and nighttime conditions.
The figure highlights that both spectral information and simple contextual features contribute to the model’s predictions.
blocks.zh:
图B.1显示了最终模型中的十大特征. 排名较高的几个特征来自火灾指数及其统计.
这包括火力指数的标准偏差,它包含了来自相邻像素的信息并帮助模型检测局部变异. 此外,3.7 μ\mu m μm的波段非常适合火灾探测,显示出高度的重要性。 有趣的是,0.47 μ \ mu m可见的波段也获得了相对较高的重视. 算法有可能利用这种可见的波段来区分白天和晚上的条件.
该图强调光谱信息和简单的背景特征都有助于模型的预测。
